initialization: Natural native OPTIONS record builder; CTK callback is registered on the UI thread, never from ptrace bootstrap. Supervisor verifies the exact CTK/mulang/language hashes and mapped bases first.

hooks.note: Native row-mask builder runs before native OPTIONS widgets. First four bytes push {r4,r5,r6,lr}; movs r0,#0x27 match in 1.82/1.85. Does not overlap ui/menu hooks.

bindings.note: CTK callback slot; supervisor requires libctk mapped at 0x29ad0000 and exact known hash. Unknown installed callbacks are left alone.

Stock canonical dgettext_ppro2 PLT address loaded as callback by FUN_00024ec4 in both exact executable versions. Wrapper preserves this original callback rather than assuming the slot contains the exported libmulang address.
